Component.description: A repository component and an honest description of its implementation stage.

id.description: Stable inventory key, unique within the descriptor.

language.description: Implemented language or an explicitly open integration choice.

layer.description: Layer that owns the module's responsibility.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the source or module boundary.

status.description: Implementation stage; this is not runtime health.

summary.description: Actual scaffold behavior or the proposed responsibility.

ComponentStatus.description: How much of a module's responsibility exists in this build.

oneOf.description: Some product behavior works; the summary states its scope and limits.
Source scaffolding exists; the summary states its actual behavior.
The module has no implemented product behavior.

Layer.description: Architectural ownership of a component, not its deployment location.

PackageRules.description:
The rules a server of this build applies to an artifact's file package.
Clients may check a draft against them before sending it; the server
checks every request regardless.

entry_path.description: The document a preview opens. Every package has it.

max_package_bytes.description: Largest sum of the sizes of a package's files, in bytes.

media_types.description:
Each accepted file extension, lowercase, with the `Content-Type` a
file with it is served with. Case is ignored when a path is checked.

description: A build-time module inventory, not a live server health response.

async_runtime.description: Selected async runtime, or null while undecided.

components.description: Modules included in this build-time inventory.

http_api.description:
Whether this build can serve the HTTP API (`artifree-server serve`).
The inventory itself is static and does not probe a running server.

mcp_api.description:
Whether `artifree-server serve` also answers MCP over Streamable HTTP
at `/mcp` on the API listener.

package_rules.description: The rules this build applies to an artifact's files.

server_framework.description: Selected HTTP framework, or null while undecided.

version.description: Version of the compiled descriptor binary.
